chapter: Childhood and first music in Oklahoma
title: Born in Oklahoma; mother and father die early
summary: McGhee was born in Oklahoma, taken to Detroit, lost his mother, was sent to his grandmother in Haskell, and his father died when he was five; a store left for him came to nothing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Right...and that's about it. [LAUGHS] No, I was born in Oklahoma, but my folks moved to Detroit, you know, when I was really young. In fact, my mother died in Detroit, because... See, she was only there for about a year before she died, so I didn't really get to know her. Then they decided to send me down to my grandmother and live back in Oklahoma -- Haskell, Oklahoma. So I went back down there...
Well, how old were you then?

Oh, about one year old. So I really didn't know my mother, you know. And my father had...he was working in a plant up in Michigan, so he decided to come back down to Oklahoma, and he came down there -- and he died
So you didn't know him too well either.

Yeah, I didn't know him at all. I know that he had invested some money in a grocery store in Bristow, Oklahoma, and my other uncle had taken that over. After he got sick, he took it over and he started running it. And he left it to me, but I never saw a trace of it. When I went to Bristow, he asked me..."I guess you want to put me through school," and school was the last thing I was thinking of at that time, because...
Well, I was maybe about twelve, twelve or thirteen, something like that.
